'''Champion Five''' was a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] from [[Champion Squadron]] who flew a [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wing]].

Prior to the [[Liberation of Coruscant (Galactic Civil War)|liberation]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], Champion Five was patrolling the [[Pyria system]] with [[Champion Six]] and [[Corran Horn/Legends|Rogue Nine]] when they challenged a [[Vengeance Derra IV|freight cruiser]] entering the system. The [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] turned out to be part of [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]]'s forces.

After a short dogfight, the cruiser retreated, leaving its entire complement of four [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighters]] and two [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE bombers]] to be killed or captured.
